name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Russian kinetic operations continue with drone incursions prompting Romanian F-16 air-policing shootdowns over the Black Sea, a strike disabling a German automotive wiring plant in Lutsk, and reciprocal Ukrainian drone swarms hitting the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal and VKontakte data centers.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage group Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) actively weaponizes BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day CVE-2026-102764 for initial network compromise, prompting emergency CISA KEV catalog directives.

name: ConnectWise Cloud Backup M365 Supply Chain Breach
summary: Compromise of ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) administrative identities allowing unauthorized threat actors to access and manipulate 173 downstream Microsoft 365 customer tenant environments.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Coordinated sabotage of Danfoss, Copeland, and Dixell BMS controllers across French supermarkets, driving ANSSI and industrial incident response teams to mandate factory resets and complete WAN network disconnections.

name: AOMEI Backupper Update Server Tampering Campaign
summary: Threat actors repeatedly compromised AOMEI's official update servers in 5-to-10-minute bursts to deliver trojanized application updates that deployed secondary backdoors onto target Windows endpoints.

name: PEERSTITCH Fortinet Edge Exploitation Wave
summary: Exploitation of path traversal flaw CVE-2025-61624 across Fortinet perimeter gateways to execute commands and inject in-memory ARM64 malware PEERSTITCH, bypassing VPN access controls.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Commercial spyware delivery network leveraging Discover-Tech's Controlium RTB platform to deliver zero-click Candiru spyware onto high-profile targets across Al Jazeera and international diplomacy.

name: n0n Maritime and Logistics Extortion Wave
summary: Financially motivated extortion collective posting exfiltrated operational EDI feeds, manifests, and system configurations from 38 port and shipping entities across 18 countries via a compromised shared logistics application.

name: YAM Store Phishing and Impersonation Ecosystem
summary: Massive Chinese-language cybercrime syndicates (YAM Store, CoGUI, Iron Man) generating over 1 billion phishing messages across 150 countries, recently targeted by joint Microsoft and Health-ISAC domain seizures.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actor UTA0576 and opportunists weaponizing CVE-2026-104935 to bypass authentication and gain root persistence across perimeter gateways, triggering urgent warnings from CISA and NBSZ NKI.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Large-scale compromise of developer accounts and enterprise code repositories, including Meta GitHub source pools, to exfiltrate proprietary code, CI secrets, and deployment keys.
